textos.texto: Ana is a student. She studies and she works in an office in the city. Her boss is very kind. Her father is an engineer and he works in a big company in Peru. Her mother is a nurse. Ana has an uncle. He is a cook, and her aunt is a teacher. Laura is a programmer and her career is very good. Paul is a doctor. He is not a student. What do you do? Ana asks. I am a waiter, says her friend, but I study to be a lawyer. And my sister is a teacher too. Which job is good? A job with a good salary!

preguntas.enunciado: ¿En qué trabaja el padre de Ana?
¿Qué quiere ser el amigo de Ana?
La madre de Ana es enfermera.

textos.texto: Good morning! What do you do? I am a driver. And you? I work at an office: I am a secretary. My husband is a police officer and my sister is a firefighter. Who is the woman with the dog? She is a farmer. Her son is a dentist and her daughter is a seller. My cousin is an architect and my friend is an accountant. How is your job? It is very good, but my salary is not good. Is Marc a teacher? No, Marc is unemployed, but he studies and he has a career. He is not a seller. What is your job, Ana? I am a student and I work at an office.

preguntas.enunciado: ¿En qué trabaja la persona que habla primero?
El marido de la secretaria es policía.
¿Cuál es la profesión de la hermana de la secretaria?

textos.texto: My father is a doctor and he works in a big company. My mother is a teacher and her office is in the city. My uncle is a driver and my aunt is a secretary. My cousin is a police officer and his wife is a nurse. My grandfather is a farmer. My brother is a cook and my sister is a dentist. And you? I am a student, but I work at a company. Is your job good? Yes, but my salary is not good. Who is the boss? Mr Lee. He is an engineer. And Marc? Marc is unemployed, but he has a career.

preguntas.enunciado: El salario de la persona que habla es bueno.
¿Cuál es la profesión de la hermana?

textos.texto: Good morning! What do you do? I am an architect, but I am unemployed. And what is your career? I study and I work. Which job is good for you here? A job in an office. How is your English? Very good. My friend is an accountant and she works at a big company. Her boss is a lawyer. My sister is a firefighter and my brother is a waiter. My mother is a seller and my father is a programmer. Is the salary good? The salary is very good. Welcome to the company! Thank you very much!

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Cuál es la profesión de la persona?
La persona vive cerca de la empresa.

textos.texto: Marie is a dentist and she works in an office. Her husband is a farmer. Her father is a doctor and her mother is a teacher. Her brother is a police officer and his wife is a nurse. Her sister is unemployed, but she studies and she has a career. Her uncle is a driver and her aunt is a secretary. Her cousin is an architect and her friend is an accountant. Who is the boss? Mr Lee. He is an engineer in a big company. Is the salary good? Yes, the salary is very good. And Marc? Marc is a cook and Sofia is a seller. What do you do?

preguntas.enunciado: ¿Cuál es la profesión de la tía?
